meta.title: Self-hosted media management and processing
meta.description: surgeMedia centralises your images and media, transforms them on demand and delivers them to your applications through a secure API.

hero.title: Your media, under your control.
hero.description: Centralise the images and videos of all your projects, crop, resize and optimise images on demand, then deliver your media to your applications through a secure API, on your own infrastructure.

transform.title: On-demand transformations
transform.description: Cropping, resizing, WebP or AVIF conversion and compression, generated on first request and then cached.

api.title: Secure API
api.description: Per-project access tokens, fine-grained permissions and allowed CORS origins for each application.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.description: Your files and data stay with you: SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, local or object storage.

sdk.title: Ready-to-use components

placeholder.pending: This video will play here as soon as its compatible version is ready.
placeholder.unplayable: Browsers cannot play this video: its format has no compatible version.

variable.title: Playback varies across browsers
variable.text: {codec} codec: some browsers or devices will not play this video. To play everywhere, upload it as H.264 (MP4) or VP9 (WebM).

faststart.title: Slower playback start
faststart.text: The index of the video is at the end of the file: the browser has to fetch it before playback starts.

duration.title: Unknown duration
duration.text: The file does not state its duration (a recording made in a browser, for example): the progress bar may be inaccurate.

location.title: Shooting location in the file
location.text: This video contains the coordinates of where it was shot: anyone who downloads it can read them.

estimated.title: Estimated duration
estimated.text: The file does not state its duration (a recording made in a browser): it was estimated from its last frames. The player discovers it during playback.

device.title: Device information
device.text: This video was uploaded before automatic preparation: it may still contain information about the device that recorded it (model, software, settings).

captions.title: No captions
captions.text: This video has sound but no subtitle track: add one (below) for deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers, and for playback without sound (WCAG 1.2.2).

compatPending.title: Compatible version in preparation
compatPending.text: {codec} codec: some browsers or devices will not play the original. An H.264 version, which plays everywhere, is being prepared: the player will offer it as soon as it is ready.

converting.title: Format converted after upload
converting.text: Browsers cannot play this format: the video will play once converted to H.264. Until then, the original is offered for download.

convertFailed.title: Format not playable
convertFailed.text: Browsers cannot play this format and its conversion failed (see “Video processing”): the original can only be downloaded.

dataTracks.title: Device data track
dataTracks.text: This file contains a data track from the device that recorded it, often GPS positions: anyone who downloads the video can read it.
dataTracks.held: This file contains a data track from the device that recorded it, often GPS positions. The processing in progress removes it: until then, the video only plays in the administration, and both its public address and its temporary links answer “503” (unavailable for now).
dataTracks.heldPrivate: This file contains a data track from the device that recorded it, often GPS positions. The processing in progress removes it: until then, the video only plays in the administration, and its temporary links answer “503” (unavailable for now).
dataTracks.failed: This file contains a data track from the device that recorded it, often GPS positions, which processing could not remove: anyone who downloads the video can read it. Make the video private or delete it if this data is sensitive.

hdr.title: HDR colours converted
hdr.text: This video is HDR: the colours of its compatible H.264 version were converted to SDR to display correctly on every screen. The original keeps its HDR colours.

hdrUnconverted.title: HDR colours not converted
hdrUnconverted.text: This video is HDR, but the server lacks the colour conversion filters: its compatible H.264 version may look dull or washed out.

snippet.title: Embed the video
snippet.description: Example for a web page: native player with its controls, no autoplay; only the metadata is loaded in advance.
snippet.privateNote: Example built with the temporary link: the video will no longer play after it expires.
snippet.pending: The example will be offered as soon as the compatible version of the video is ready: browsers cannot play its original format.
snippet.unavailable: No version of this video can be played by browsers: there is no player example to offer.

prepare.title: Optimise the video
prepare.description: Moves the index to the start of the file and removes the original metadata (shooting location, device), without re-encoding or quality loss. Creates a new version: old addresses redirect to the new one.
prepare.unchanged: Nothing to change: the video is already ready for online playback.

links.privateDescription: This media item is private: generate a temporary link to share it or display it outside the administration.
links.outdated: The video was updated by processing: create a new temporary link.

replace.title: Replace the file

generator.title: URL builder
generator.description: Compose a transformed version of the image (size, crop, quality, format), then copy its address or an HTML example. The preview is computed on the fly, without creating a file.

params.label: Parameters
params.description: Size, density, framing, area, quality, background, rotation, mirror.

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: A transformation saved for the space: built-in, global or project.

generator.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields to update the preview and the address.
generator.reduced: The original image is smaller than the requested size: the result is reduced while keeping the requested ratio (never enlarged).
generator.previewNote: Computed for this preview without creating a file: the file is generated on the first visit of the address.
generator.refused: This space only accepts presets: an address with free parameters would be refused. Choose a preset, or create one with these parameters.

urlKinds.permanent: Permanent address, cached without limit by browsers and CDNs.
urlKinds.preset: Permanent address. The preset can be changed: the image will follow its definition (one-week cache).
urlKinds.signed: Signed address without expiry: this space requires a signature for free parameters.

generator.urlExpiring: Temporary link (private media item): it expires on {date}.
generator.snippetsDescription: HTML examples built with the addresses above; check the alternative text.

img.title: Simple image
img.description: An img tag with its dimensions: the page does not shift while it loads.

picture.title: Several formats
picture.description: The browser takes the first format it can display (AVIF, then WebP), otherwise the fallback image. The same address works for every format, signature included.

srcset.title: High-density screens
srcset.description: 1x, 2x (and 3x when the image allows it) versions: the browser picks one according to the screen resolution.

errors.PRESET_NOT_FOUND: This preset no longer exists: reload the page.
errors.INVALID_TRANSFORM: This transformation is not possible on this image, or is no longer accepted by the server.

generator.presetHint: Presets usable in this space: built-in, global and project ones.
generator.densityHint: Multiplies the width and height for high-resolution screens; the image displays at the requested size.
generator.densityUnused: Without a width or height, the density has no effect.

webp.label: WebP — recommended
webp.hint: A good balance between weight and quality, read by every current browser.

avif.label: AVIF — the lightest
avif.hint: The lightest files; slightly longer to generate on the first visit.

jpg.label: JPEG — maximum compatibility
jpg.hint: Read everywhere, including old software; no transparency (white background by default).

png.label: PNG — lossless
png.hint: Perfect quality and transparency; heavier files (logos, screenshots).

generator.durationHint: The media item is private: the address is signed and stops working when it expires.

crop.cleared: Area cleared: the whole image is used.

poster.removeDescription: The video will no longer have a thumbnail or an image before playback. A new version is created.
poster.captureFailed: The frame could not be captured: the video is not loaded yet, or your browser cannot decode it. Start playback and try again, or upload an image.

errors.unsupported: This file is not an accepted image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF).
errors.tooLarge: The image exceeds the maximum size ({max}).

tracks.removeDescription: The “{label}” track will no longer be offered by the player.

kindHints.SUBTITLES: Translation or transcription of the dialogue, for viewers who hear the sound.
kindHints.CAPTIONS: Dialogue and meaningful sounds (music, noises, speakers), for viewers who do not hear the sound.
kindHints.DESCRIPTIONS: Text description of the images, for viewers who do not see them.
kindHints.CHAPTERS: Titles of the parts of the video, to navigate through it.

fields.fileHint: WebVTT (.vtt) or SRT, 1 MB at most.
fields.label: Label
fields.labelHint: Name offered by the player, preferably in the language of the track.
fields.defaultHint: Shown without any user action (one per group: subtitles, descriptions, chapters).

errors.language: Invalid language code (BCP 47 tag expected, for example “fr” or “en-GB”).
errors.label: The label must not contain control characters.
errors.invalid: This file is not a valid subtitle file (WebVTT or SRT).

errors.limit: This video already has {max} tracks: delete one to add another.

processing.title: Video processing
processing.never: This video has never been processed (uploaded before video processing was enabled, or while it was inactive). Processing checks the file, removes device data tracks, extracts a poster image if one is missing and prepares a compatible version when useful.
processing.queued: The video is in the queue: processing will start as soon as the server can take it.
processing.retryScheduled: Another attempt is scheduled after a temporary failure.
processing.interrupted: Processing interrupted: the media item is in the trash. It will resume if the media item is restored.

errors.NO_VIDEO_TRACK: The file contains no video track.
errors.UNREADABLE: The file is unreadable or damaged: it could not be analysed.
errors.CONVERSION_FAILED: The conversion failed, or the version produced did not pass verification.
errors.TOO_LONG: The video exceeds the maximum processing duration set on the server: no compatible version was produced.
errors.SOURCE_MISSING: The original file cannot be found in storage.
errors.FFMPEG_UNAVAILABLE: ffmpeg is missing or unusable on the processing server: contact the administrator.

backfill.title: Process existing videos
backfill.description: Creates a job for every video never processed (uploaded before processing was enabled, or while it was inactive), excluding the trash; they are handled after new uploads. Those that contain a device data track (GPS positions) go first: their file is replaced by a copy without that track (new version, old addresses redirect) and, until then, their public address and temporary links answer “503” (unavailable for now).

estimateNote.auto: Rough estimate, based on the total duration and the encoding settings: videos that are already compatible are not re-encoded, and the actual speed depends on the machine.
estimateNote.always: Rough estimate, based on the total duration and the encoding settings: every video gets an H.264 version, and the actual speed depends on the machine.
estimateNote.never: Rough estimate: no H.264 version is produced (checks, poster, data track removal and WebM repair only), and the actual speed depends on the machine.

backfill.estimateShort: Estimated processing time: less than a minute.
backfill.disabledInactive: Available when video processing is active.
backfill.disabledEmpty: Nothing to process: every video has already been processed or is queued.

Those that contain a device data track (GPS positions) go first, their file is replaced by a copy without that track and, until then, their public address and temporary links answer “503”.

invitation.textAction: To choose your password and activate your account, open this link:
invitation.expires: This link is personal and works only once. It is valid until {date}.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, simply ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your {app} password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.intro: {sender} requested a password reset for your {app} account ({email}).
reset.textAction: To choose a new password, open this link:
reset.expires: This link is personal and works only once. It is valid until {date}; your current password keeps working until then.
reset.ignore: If you did not request this, let your administrator know.

enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled on {app}
enabled.heading: Two-factor authentication enabled
enabled.intro: Two-factor authentication was enabled on your {app} account ({email}) on {date}. Every sign-in will now ask for a code from your app.

disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication disabled on {app}
disabled.heading: Two-factor authentication disabled
disabled.intro: Two-factor authentication was disabled on your {app} account ({email}) on {date}. Your password alone is enough to sign in again.

reset.subject: Two-factor authentication reset on {app}
reset.heading: Two-factor authentication reset
reset.intro: Two-factor authentication on your {app} account ({email}) was reset by {by} on {date}. Your app no longer works for this account: set it up again from “My account”, or at your next sign-in if your organization requires it.

recoveryUsed.subject: Recovery code used on {app}
recoveryUsed.heading: Signed in with a recovery code
recoveryUsed.intro: A recovery code was used to sign in to {app} ({email}) on {date}. You have {remaining} left. If you lost your app, set up two-factor authentication again from “My account”.

mfa.notYou: If you did not make this change, tell your administrator right away.

setup.intro: With an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, Aegis…):
setup.step1: Scan this QR code with the app, or type in the key.
setup.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.openLink: On this phone? Open in the authenticator app

codes.description: If you lose your app, these codes let you sign in. Each one works only once. They will not be shown again: copy or download them, then keep them somewhere safe.
codes.confirm: I have saved these codes somewhere safe

errors.MFA_CODE_INVALID: Incorrect or already used code. Check your phone's clock and try again.
errors.MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: The verification time ran out. Sign in again.
errors.MFA_UNAVAILABLE: Two-factor authentication is unavailable on this server (encryption key missing or changed). Tell the operator.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY: Your organization requires two-factor authentication: it cannot be turned off.
errors.MFA_SELF_RESET: For your own account, use “My account”.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.unexpected: The operation failed. Try again in a moment.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your identity and the security of your account.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: A code from your authenticator app is asked at every sign-in, on top of your password.
mfa.required: Your organization requires two-factor authentication for your account.
mfa.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is not available on this server: the encryption key (NUXT_MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY) is not set.
mfa.codesLeft: No recovery codes left | {count} recovery code left | {count} recovery codes left
mfa.codesLow: You have few recovery codes left: regenerate them.
mfa.regenerateHint: The current codes will stop working.
mfa.disableDescription: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code, to confirm.
mfa.regeneratedDone: New recovery codes generated: the old ones no longer work.
mfa.devices: Trusted devices are managed from the dashboard.

banner.label: Public demo
banner.title: Public demo.
banner.reset: Reset at {time}: everything you add will be erased.

accounts.title: Demo accounts
accounts.description: Sign in with one of these accounts. All visitors share them, and they can't be changed.

account.mfa: Two-factor authentication can't be turned on for a shared demo account. To try it, create your own account in Users.

demo.readOnly: In the demo, this setting is read-only.

readOnly.media: This media item is part of the demo's example content: duplicate it to change it.
readOnly.setting: In the demo, this setting is read-only.
readOnly.item: This item is part of the demo's example content: create your own to try this action.

errors.quota: The demo's upload volume is used up until the next reset, in {minutes} min.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.description: Publisher and host of this public demonstration of surgeMedia.

report.title: Report content
report.text: This demo holds files uploaded by its visitors. To report illegal content, write to {address}, giving the page or file concerned and the reason for the report. The content is removed promptly, and in any case at the next reset.

software.title: Software and content
software.text: surgeMedia is published under the Business Source License 1.1. The demo's example content belongs to its authors and cannot be reused without their consent.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What the demo records, why, and for how long.

data.title: Data processed
data.logs: Server logs: IP address, date and time, page or file requested, browser. They keep the demo secure and help fight abuse (the publisher's legitimate interest), and are kept for {days} day. | Server logs: IP address, date and time, page or file requested, browser. They keep the demo secure and help fight abuse (the publisher's legitimate interest), and are kept for {days} days.
data.cookies: Cookies: session cookies, set when you sign in, and preference cookies (language, theme). They are needed for the demo to work; there is no audience measurement, advertising or third-party tracker.
data.content: What you add (media, accounts, projects, text): erased at the next reset, every {interval}. Don't put any personal data in it.
data.visits: Visit count: each sign-in to a demo account adds one line to the server log, with the account's role only, without IP address or email.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.text: This data is only available to the publisher and the server's host ({host}). It is never sold, transferred or used for advertising.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to access, correct or erase your data, or object to its processing, by writing to {email}. You can also lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country (in France, the CNIL).

terms.title: Demo terms
terms.description: The rules for using this public demonstration.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: This demo lets you try surgeMedia. It is free and provided as is, with no guarantee of availability or of keeping data. Using it means accepting these terms.

reset.title: Reset
reset.text: Every {interval}, the demo goes back to its example content: everything you added or changed (media, accounts, projects, settings) is erased and cannot be recovered.

sharing.title: Shared space
sharing.text: Demo accounts are shared: other signed-in visitors see what you upload. Your files are only served to visitors signed in to the demo; a link shared elsewhere doesn't show them.

items.personal: personal data, yours or anyone else's;
items.illegal: illegal, hateful, violent or pornographic content, or content that infringes the rights of others (copyright, image rights);
items.malware: malware, phishing pages or any content meant to deceive;
items.hosting: files to host or distribute: the demo is not a hosting service.

report.title: Reports and removal
report.text: To report content, write to {address}. The publisher promptly removes reported or obviously illegal content; it may reset the demo at once and block a visitor who does not follow these terms.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: You are responsible for what you upload. The publisher is not liable for the erasure of data, which is how the demo works, nor for its interruptions.

contact.title: Questions
contact.text: For any question about the demo or surgeMedia, write to {email}.
